title: I'd like to use my phone a bit

messages.text: I'd like to use my phone a bit

Yes, go ahead: the phone is yours. Nothing is running on it, and no test needs it right now.
- I hold the phone for you (30 min), so no agent can open a page or run a test on it.
- You can unplug it if you like. Plug it back in when you're done.
- The next phone test (the end-menu fix check) isn't ready yet. If it gets ready first, it waits for you.
What you need to do: reply "done" here when you're finished, and I'll release the phone to the team.

Thanks, the phone is back with the team.
- It is connected again, and I released it, so the next test can use it.
What you need to do: nothing.
